name: RoyalBoar
identity: Very round bright golden boar with ochre oval spots, cream-and-gold swept forelock, pointed gold ears, huge ivory upward tusks and four tiny golden hoof feet. No crown. Original atlas and six serialized renderers have NO independent tail sprite or tail binding; do not invent a tail.
actual_source_observation: Actually viewed original atlas and complete battle prefab offline rendering. Four legs, round torso with integrated original forelock/ears; separate original facial slice contains eyes, muzzle, tusks. Vertical view assigns tuft and ears exclusively to the head slice, no duplicate hair on body. No independent tail in atlas or six-renderer source.
vertical_distribution: Head owns ears and cream swept forelock. Torso owns ochre spots and small original flank fur points only. Transparent compatibility Tail, no rig tail node.
